title: frameledger bisect --json
description: The result of `frameledger bisect --json`: one commit judged for `git bisect run`. A later release may add keys, and values to the open sets; a script ignores what it does not know. Print this file from the same frameledger that printed the result.

frameledger.description: The version of the frameledger that printed this.

summary.description: The opening sentences of the text output, in order. Wording may change in any release.

overrides.description: The --override flags given; empty for a command that takes none.

warnings.description: The warnings, each also a sentence in summary.

category.description: The row's category. An open set: today frame, cpu, gpu or mem.

depth.description: The depth judged at, or null when none was settled.

unit.description: The unit of the measure's values. An open set that follows from category: today ms, or MB for mem.

measure.description: The measure the commit is judged by.

dry_run.description: True under --dry-run, which judges a given value and reads no tested run.

name.description: The run's name in this result: its set and its place in it, such as tested-1.

run_id.description: The header's run_id; null in a short entry.

commit.description: The header's commit; null when unknown, and in a short entry.

dirty.description: The header's dirty; null when unknown, and in a short entry.

started_utc.description: The header's started_utc; null in a short entry.

rows_dropped.description: The close line's count of rows the writer dropped; null when the run has no close line, and in a short entry.

finished.description: Whether the run has a close line; null in a short entry.

under_load.description: The name of each machine-load peak above its limit, empty for a run not taken under load; null in a short entry.

generated_frames.description: How many of the run's frames a frame generator made; null in a short entry.

value.description: The run's value of the measure; null when it has none.

runs.description: Every run named: the tested, then the good and bad references. A run that could not be read, or that breaks the format, has a short entry: its name, set and path, and null for the rest.

value.description: The tested value, or the dry run's; null when the verdict is skip or stop.

bad_above.description: The line a value above which is bad: --bad-above's, or the midpoint of the references; null when it was not settled.

good_centre.description: The centre of the good runs' values.

bad_centre.description: The centre of the bad runs' values.

spread.description: How far the reference runs of a set disagree.

floor.description: The smallest gap between good and bad that counts.

references.description: The reference runs' figures; null in threshold mode, and when they were not settled.

refused.description: The blocking header fields that differ between the runs; not empty only when that stopped the bisect.

all_frames.description: Whether --all-frames counted the frames a frame generator made.

result.description: The judgement. Every key is always written.

bisect_verdict.description: The verdict of bisect: good or bad for the commit, skip when it cannot be judged, stop when the bisect cannot go on. A closed set.

bisect_exit_code.description: The exit codes a bisect result can carry. A closed set.

code.description: What kind of warning it is. An open set: a later release may add a code, and a script ignores one it does not know. file_error says a file could not be read.

warning.description: One warning. Its sentence is also in summary.

field.description: The header field that may differ.

override.description: One blocking field a --override flag let differ.

statistic.description: How a run's frames become one value: the median or the 99th percentile, nearest-rank. A closed set.

bisect_set.description: Which set a run belongs to. A closed set.

skip_reason.description: The first reason the commit cannot be judged; null unless the verdict is skip. A closed set.

additionalProperties.description: Any JSON value: it is the engine's own.

values.description: Each run's value of the field, keyed by run name.

refusal.description: One blocking header field whose values differ between the runs.
